report.summary: Both failures come from one cause: list_books() in app/main.py sleeps for a random 0-8 seconds on every /books render, so any page load or form submit that lands on a long draw exceeds the 5 s Playwright timeout set in tests/ui/conftest.py. Fix the app first by removing that sleep (or gating it off outside a deliberate test), and do not raise the test timeouts or treat these as product bugs.

causes.title: Random server delay in list_books makes UI page loads time out
causes.explanation: app/main.py:150 calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) inside list_books(). list_books is called by books_page (via render_books) on every GET /books and by render_books after a failed POST /books. The UI tests run with a 5000 ms Playwright timeout (tests/ui/conftest.py:7). Whenever the random draw is above roughly 5 s, page.goto('/books') in the login test fails with 'Timeout 5000ms exceeded' while waiting for the 'load' event. In the books test, the POST /books response (422 from the future-year validation, rendered via render_books) is delayed the same way, so the locator.click() waits for the scheduled navigation and times out. The tests are right; the app is intermittently slow, so the outcome depends on chance and the same code can pass on a rerun. The fixture docstring at tests/ui/conftest.py:6 says nothing in the app should take longer than 5 s, which this sleep contradicts. Both tests were the only UI tests in the run that rely on a /books render under the timeout.
evidence: app/main.py:256: "books": list_books(user["id"]),  (render_books, used by books_page and by the 422 path of books_add)
tests/ui/conftest.py:6-7: "Nothing in this app should take longer than 5 s..." / page.set_default_timeout(5000)
Login test error: 'Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. Call log: navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:63944/books", waiting until "load"' (tests/ui/test_login_ui.py:37 -> tests/support/pages.py:34)

Books test error: 'Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded' ... 'waiting for scheduled navigations to finish' at tests/support/pages.py:44, from tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:42. The button was visible, enabled and stable, so the click itself was not the problem.
app/main.py:336: return RedirectResponse("/books", status_code=303)  (successful add redirects to a GET /books that also hits list_books)
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) from list_books in app/main.py (or, if it simulates latency on purpose, make it opt-in via an environment variable that the test server does not set). Do not raise the 5 s timeout or add retries to hide it. After the fix, rerun both tests several times to confirm they are stable. Also correct the fixture docstring in tests/ui/conftest.py if the app is expected to be slower than 5 s in some configurations.
